rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Kasturi Rangan (India, before 1990).
Introduced in India by KSG Sons/KSG's Roses in 1990 as 'Bhanu'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, light pink outer petals. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
